title: Building Hardware and Taking on the Phone Giants

reader_summary.headline: I think there's a lot of people like us who are tech fans out there and who remember being Apple fanboys and fan girls..
reader_summary.overview: I think there's a lot of people like us who are tech fans out there and who remember being Apple fanboys and fan girls. People often say that building a hardware company is like building on hard mode. While building a hardware company during a global pandemic, with the unpredictability of supply chains and markets, that's harder than hard.

thesis: The episode discusses the extreme difficulty of building hardware companies, particularly in the smartphone market dominated by Apple and Samsung, and highlights how startups often fail because they cannot afford to fail unlike large incumbents. The founder of Nothing explains his strategy of starting with audio products to prove team capabilities before attempting to enter the smartphone market, noting that many previous startups failed because they lost the trust of ODMs and supply chains.
